conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLA: Checked the clause: EO 5700 has one operative paragraph that only amends Executive Order No. 9. EO 11408 section 2 revokes every prior order insofar as it amends Executive Order No. 9 and names 5700 expressly, and section 1 revokes Executive Order No. 9 itself, so the revocation reaches the whole of EO 5700, not a part. The later amendments of Executive Order No. 9 for other officers (EO 9845, 10044, 10055, 10645) do not alter EO 5700, and EO 11408 lists them too.

notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 5700 only amends Executive Order No. 9 of January 17, 1873 to permit officeholding. Executive Order 11408 (signed April 25, 1968; held 33 FR 6459 text) revokes Executive Order No. 9 in section 1 and in section 2 revokes the amendatory orders, listing '5700, August 31, 1931'. The order has been ended since 1968-04-25; the held 1989 editorial snapshot ('Revokedby EO 11408') agrees but is not the basis.
